text:
Priya Nair: Quick update — org tweak and a couple of intros. Effective today the Platform PM group is moving under Product Ops and will be led by Aisha Patel (promoted to Head of Platform PMs). This is to tighten the product-to-serving feedback loop for Redwood Optimize. Aisha will own roadmap prioritization for platform-level features + rollout coordination for Dedicated and Private.

Priya Nair: As part of this, Aisha will temporarily take on two open PMs from Growth for 6 weeks while we post a backfill for her previous IC role. We intend to hire a senior PM (IC) to replace her — job req and interview plan below.

Priya Nair: Also — please welcome Marco Ruiz, who joins as Staff Platform Engineer and will partner with Aisha on runtime integrations and the new batching controls. Marco starts Mon and will be paired with Lena for the first two weeks.

Aisha Patel: Super excited. Thanks Priya and the hiring team for the quick turn here. Looking forward to syncing with Product and Eng on backlog re-prioritization. :tada:

Marco Ruiz: Hi everyone — happy to be here! Previously built infra for real-time systems at my last startup. Open to 1:1s this week; booking link in my profile.

Lena Cho: Welcome Marco! Quick question on reporting: will Platform Eng still report to Eng leads as before, or any dotted line to Aisha for product priorities?

Priya Nair: Good Q. Org reporting stays the same for Eng (dotted product priority line to Aisha). Day-to-day work and performance reviews remain with Eng managers. Aisha will run quarterly prioritization reviews with Eng leads.

Tom Baker: Recruiting note — req for the senior PM backfill (REQ-PLT-112) is live. Interview loop: hiring manager (Aisha), 2x pm bar interviews, 1x technical systems interview, 1x partnered-customer session. We want on-site (onsite==virtual loop) within 3 weeks. I can post scheduling threads once we get candidates.

Aisha Patel: Hiring rubric is in the doc: https://redwoodinternal.example.com/reqs/PLT-112 — focus areas: product sense for infra, latency-first tradeoffs, and rollout/ops experience. Please DM Tom if you want to be on the loop.

hr-bot: New hire processes initiated for Marco Ruiz. Onboarding checklist created and assigned to his manager. Link: https://hr.redwood.example.com/onboarding/Marco_Ruiz

Priya Nair: Action items for managers: 1) Update your 1:1 rosters in PeopleStack to reflect temporary coverage; 2) Aisha, please publish your first 90-day priorities by end of next week; 3) Eng leads — expect a prioritization sync invite from Aisha.

Aisha Patel: I'll post the 90-day and a quick kickoff doc by Friday.

Marco Ruiz: Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff. Team, ping me for any infra questions.

Lena Cho: Thanks all. Congrats Aisha and welcome Marco!

Tom Baker: If anyone knows strong senior PM candidates with infra/product experience, please send referrals to me; referral bonus applies. :rocket:

Priya Nair: That's it for the update — feel free to drop any questions here or DM me. :white_check_mark:
